name: AppSkyline
description: Connect AppSkyline to Claude to inspect the apps and keywords your organization tracks across the iOS App Store, Google Play and Microsoft Store. Ask for a current keyword rank, review tracked keywords and their history, compare apps, or manage the keywords you monitor. AppSkyline uses OAuth, so each person sees only the data their own AppSkyline account is allowed to access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AppSkyline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AppSkyline to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.appskyline.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AppSkyline MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppSkyline provides these MCP tools: add_keyword, delete_keyword, get_app, get_keyword_history, get_keyword_rank, list_apps, list_keywords, search_store_results, and show_app_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AppSkyline?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AppSkyline in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
AppSkyline requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AppSkyline is developed by Waiterio LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
